purpose: Define optimizer statistics as derived, revision/snapshot-bound evidence about data distribution, size and selectivity rather than canonical domain facts.

topics.name: DWH Statistics Evidence
topics.purpose: Define optimizer statistics as derived, revision/snapshot-bound evidence about data distribution, size and selectivity rather than canonical domain facts.

semantics.identity_rule: Each statistics set/evidence record has an explicit identity.
semantics.scope_rule: Statistics reference exact schema/resource/field and source revision/snapshot/watermark.
semantics.derived_rule: Statistics are derived evidence and never canonical business/domain truth.
semantics.freshness_rule: Collection time and source revision/watermark are explicit.
semantics.stale_rule: Stale statistics remain identifiable and may affect planning quality but not query semantics.
semantics.privacy_rule: Statistics exposure obeys governance where distributions may reveal sensitive information.
semantics.authority_rule: Statistics do not grant source data authorization.

invariants.rule: Indexes, statistics, caches and optimizer plans may change execution strategy only; they never change canonical query semantics, data identity, ownership, classification or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: stale stats treated as current without evidence

references.purpose: Statistics can bind exact captured state.

prose.summary: Define optimizer statistics as derived, revision/snapshot-bound evidence about data distribution, size and selectivity rather than canonical domain facts.
